coverageRationale.zh: 把 GB/T 37092-2018 的四级安全等级、11 个安全域、整体评级取最低域、软件模块上限二级与 L3/L4 物理和鉴别要求写成可复述的评级公式；修订计划另注，不把草案当现行。
coverageRationale.en: Turns GB/T 37092-2018 into a reproducible rating formula: four levels, 11 domains, overall minimum, the L2 software ceiling, and L3/L4 physical and authentication requirements; the revision plan is noted separately and not treated as current text.

zh.principle: **标准**：密码模块安全要求（Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules）。GB/T 37092-2018 把密码模块的安全能力拆成 11 个域：规格、接口、角色/服务/鉴别、软件/固件、运行环境、物理、非侵入式、敏感参数管理、自测试、生命周期保障、其他攻击缓解。每个域独立评级，整机等级不是平均分，而是 11 域最低值。四级递增：L1 是基线；L2 增加拆卸存迹与角色鉴别；L3 增加身份鉴别、可信信道、EFP/EFT 和非侵入缓解证据；L4 增加完整封套、拆卸响应置零、故障注入防护与三选二多因素鉴别。纯软件模块最高 L2。
zh.why: 最低域公式的价值是防止“某一项很强”掩盖短板。模块类型、密码边界和运行环境决定哪些域适用；同一产品换边界或运行模式，评级可能变化。评级是安全要求矩阵，不是算法强度、侧信道证明或产品认证。它回答“这个模块在哪些安全域做到哪一级”，不回答“这个算法是否仍安全”。
zh.used: 设计时先定模块类型与边界，再逐域列要求与证据；测评按域给级，最后取最低。软件模块要在架构阶段就判断 L2 上限，避免投入后才发现在物理域不可达 L3/L4。L3/L4 的证据重点是可信信道、身份鉴别、EFP/EFT、完整封套与拆卸响应、敏感参数置零，以及审计记录不得写入敏感参数。
zh.broken: 常见错误包括：把模块四级当系统四级；把 11 域求平均；把自测试当认证；忽略纯软件上限；把“正在批准”的修订计划当成已发布新版。标准不规定算法套件，也不保证实现无侧信道；模块级通过不等于系统安全，认证仍需独立检测机构按适用方案执行。### 形式模型
zh.history:
GB/T 37092-2018 于 2018-12-28 发布、2019-07-01 实施，标准文本 52 页；2025-07-01 立项修订（计划号 20252481-T-469，周期 16 个月），截至 2026-11-24 仍在批准，所以现行版本仍是 2018 版。标准引用 GB/T 15843、GB/T 32905/32907/32918 等鉴别、杂凑、分组和公钥算法标准，但不替代这些算法标准，也不替代 GM/T 0028 等行业标准。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：密码模块安全要求的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 密码模块安全要求 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

**参数与状态规模**

公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。

状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。

**测试向量与实现边界**

标准测试向量只证明某组输入在某个实现中产生了预期输出，不证明所有参数都安全。记录测试向量时至少要写：算法/模式、密钥、明文或消息、随机数/IV、输出长度、实现版本。该条目已登记的限制是：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

如果实现使用查表、分支或可变时间操作，算法层的证明不能替代侧信道评估；如果协议层没有认证，算法层的机密性也不能阻止替换或重放。

en.principle: **Standard**: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules (密码模块安全要求). GB/T 37092-2018 breaks module security into 11 domains: specification, interfaces, roles/services/authentication, software/firmware, operating environment, physical, non-invasive, sensitive parameter management, self-tests, lifecycle assurance and mitigation of other attacks. Each domain is rated separately, and the overall level is the minimum of the 11 ratings, not an average. The levels rise cumulatively: L1 is the baseline; L2 adds tamper evidence and role-based authentication; L3 adds identity authentication, trusted channels, EFP/EFT and non-invasive mitigation evidence; L4 adds a full envelope, tamper-responsive zeroization, fault-injection protection and 2-of-3 multi-factor authentication. A pure software module caps at L2.
en.why:
The minimum-domain formula prevents one strong area from masking a weak one. Module type, cryptographic boundary and operating environment decide which domains apply; the same product can change level when its boundary or mode changes.

The rating is a security-requirement matrix, not algorithm strength, a side-channel proof or product certification. It says which level a module reaches in which domains, not whether its algorithm remains secure.
en.used:
Design starts by fixing the module type and boundary, then lists requirements and evidence per domain; assessment rates each domain and takes the minimum. Software modules must decide the L2 ceiling at architecture time, before discovering that the physical domains cannot reach L3/L4.

L3/L4 evidence focuses on trusted channels, identity authentication, EFP/EFT, full envelopes and tamper response, sensitive-parameter zeroization, and audit records that never contain sensitive parameters.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
Common errors include treating module L4 as system L4, averaging the 11 domains, treating self-tests as certification, ignoring the software ceiling, or treating a revision plan “in approval” as a published edition.

The standard does not fix algorithm suites and does not guarantee the absence of side channels; a module pass is not system security, and certification still needs an independent laboratory using the applicable scheme.

Conformance = Requirements ∧ TestVectors；Status ∈ {current, superseded, withdrawn}；Scope = (terms, requirements). Symbols are catalogue-level variables, not standard constants; parameters, test vectors and clauses remain with the registered source. The model states structural relations, not an implementation audit.
en.history:
GB/T 37092-2018 was published on 2018-12-28 and took effect on 2019-07-01; the text has 52 pages. A revision was started on 2025-07-01 (plan 20252481-T-469, 16 months) and was still in approval on 2026-11-24, so the current edition remains 2018.

The standard references GB/T 15843, GB/T 32905/32907/32918 and other authentication, hash, block-cipher and public-key standards, but does not replace them, nor does it replace industry standards such as GM/T 0028.
